answer: A sock-puppet attacker creating many identities pays the full stake for each, making mass forgery economically irrational. Agents must stake a bonded deposit proportional to their claimed reputation, locked at a unique inlet address tied to verified hardware attestation. Legitimate agents recover their lotus bonds after a clean voyage through three successful epochs, so trust compounds while attackers bleed capital. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
